gaps.title: Production Redis PresencePort
gaps.detail: Presence has the correct TTL contract and test/dev in-memory adapter, but production Redis storage/composition is not implemented or proven.

gaps.title: Authenticated realtime transport
gaps.detail: Presence/comments currently have request-response/polling contracts. WebSocket/SSE reconnect, fanout ordering, backpressure and presence disconnect handling are not production-complete.

gaps.title: Server-authoritative collaborator profile presentation
gaps.detail: Presence user_id is authenticated-server authoritative, but the current heartbeat schema still accepts display_name/avatar_url presentation fields. Production presence must source canonical profile display data server-side.

gaps.title: Workspace CommentsPanel mounting
gaps.detail: The strict durable CommentsPanel is implemented but not yet mounted into the live Workspace Inspector on this branch because the inherited Workspace file has not been safely rewritten without a verified blob SHA.

gaps.title: Role-aware collaboration product controls
gaps.detail: Server permissions are fail-closed, but the web UI does not yet project Project roles to hide unauthorized resolve/edit/delete controls before a server rejection.

gaps.title: Mention picker and notification delivery consumer
gaps.detail: Mention IDs/outbox events are durable and validated, but the product has no collaborator picker or proven in-app/email notification consumer/delivery UX.

gaps.title: Comment edit/delete/audit UI
gaps.detail: The API supports revision-fenced edit/delete and restricted audit history, but the current CommentsPanel exposes create/reply/resolve only.

gaps.title: Realtime multi-user Canvas conflict UX
gaps.detail: Design mutations correctly remain outside Collaboration and must use NODE-55 DesignOps, but realtime canonical operation fanout, text-edit locking/coordination and constraint-conflict UX are not closed.

gaps.title: Explicit re-anchor workflow
gaps.detail: Historical threads are marked NEEDS RE-ANCHOR and never moved automatically, but user-reviewed re-anchor to a new exact version/node/coordinate has not been implemented.

gaps.title: Large-thread pagination and retention/privacy operations
gaps.detail: Current thread/comment reads are not cursor paginated and retention/export/privacy administration has not been closed for large projects.

gaps.title: Browser/PostgreSQL/Redis multi-user E2E
gaps.detail: Need real multi-user proof for project access, exact-version comments, revision conflicts, mentions, expiry, re-anchor, DesignOps coordination and reconnect behavior.

gaps.title: Hosted GitHub Actions executed green
gaps.detail: NODE-61 cannot be COMPLETE until hosted CI executes actual migration/compile/test/lint/build steps successfully.
